Fixed bug 441116: [api] Create functional interface to use Lambda
expressions for selection events based on SelectionListener - fixed jdt
ui code

Change-Id: I640f3d98b27b99310d4afdd209ca456c691baf6b
dslRule:
<!id: selectionlistener.explicit-null-cast>
<!description: Add explicit cast to SelectionEvent for null argument in SelectionListener.widgetSelected().
This clarifies intent and can help type inference, especially with functional interfaces.>
<!severity: HINT>

$listener.widgetSelected(null) :: instanceof($listener, "org.eclipse.swt.events.SelectionListener")
=>
$listener.widgetSelected((org.eclipse.swt.events.SelectionEvent) null)
;;
summary: Adds an explicit cast `(SelectionEvent) null` to `null` arguments passed to `SelectionListener.widgetSelected()`.

commitMessage:
Bug 501452: Add option to set JavaDocView's text color

Change-Id: Ie536a79f6a4bbcb7d5965692d35f695b842498ca
Task-Url: https://bugs.eclipse.org/bugs/show_bug.cgi?id=501452
Signed-off-by: Leo Ufimtsev <lufimtse@redhat.com>
dslRule:
<!id: javadocview.htmlprinter.foreground>
<!description: In JavadocView, pass the foreground color field to HTMLPrinter.insertPageProlog instead of null, enabling text coloring.
This transformation is part of a feature implementation introduced in the commit to add custom foreground color support to JavadocView. It ensures that the foreground color is correctly applied when rendering HTML content.
>
<!severity: HINT>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.HTMLPrinter.insertPageProlog($buffer, 0, null, $backgroundColorRGB, $fgStyleSheet) :: inClass("org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.infoviews.JavadocView")
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.text.HTMLPrinter.insertPageProlog($buffer, 0, fForegroundColorRGB, $backgroundColorRGB, $fgStyleSheet)
;;
summary: Replaces `null` with `fForegroundColorRGB` as the foreground color argument in `HTMLPrinter.insertPageProlog` calls within the `JavadocView` class. This applies the newly introduced foreground color option.
